title: Private Bachelorette Booze Cruise
includes: Optional food and stocked bar with choice of adult beverages and mixers
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: All sales are final. No refund is available for cancellations.
blurb:
Celebrate in true Nashville bachelorette style with the ultimate alcohol-themed party adventure! Gather your crew and hop aboard a 21-passenger VIP party bus, premium sound system, LED lights, and a fun, energetic driver who keeps the vibes going all day long.

This all-inclusive Nashville tour features tastings at one local brewery and one Tennessee distillery (or two distilleries if preferred), plus a stop at a scenic winery where you’ll receive a generous gift card to use toward tastings, food, or wine purchases.

With approximately six hours of non-stop fun, this experience blends Nashville’s best brews, spirits, and wines into one unforgettable celebration. Perfect for bride tribes, birthdays, or group getaways, it’s the most exciting way to experience Music City’s craft scene in VIP style.
